summary: Hampshire County, MA lookout on Mount Warner, built 1939 and removed 1940; footings photographed in 2014; Trustees reservation open to visitors today.

access.note: The Trustees' Mount Warner reservation is open sunrise to sunset and admission is free; no source says whether the footings lie inside it

visit.trail_note: Salamander Loop Trail on the Trustees reservation; no tower remains to climb

events.note: Photo caption shows the tower footings in 2014
Registered May 27, 2016; nominated by Jack Kelley

evidence.quote: Mount Warner Fire Tower was built in 1939 and removed in 1940. The tower had concrete footings.

evidence.supports: on Mount Warner Road, North Hadley
open daily from sunrise to sunset
Salamander Loop climbs through hardwoods toward evergreen groves
evidence.quote: Ascend through oak, beech, and other hardwoods along the Salamander Loop Trail as it transitions to evergreen groves further upslope.

notes_for_editor: Only one register entry and the Trustees page were readable, so all dates rest on the FFLOS record. Two FFLAMASS Facebook posts about this tower appeared in search results (a 'temporary lookout' into the early 1940s; a 'wooden tripod fire tower' from 1939 to 1940), but fetch_text returned only their titles, so they are not cited and their tower-type claims are unverified. No photos added; the 2014 footings photo is on the register page but its image URL was not retrievable.
